label: False paths and clock groups
subgoals: Remove checks with set_false_path only on paths that never propagate in operation

label: Multicycle paths and absolute delays
subgoals: Move the setup check to the N-th edge with set_multicycle_path N -setup
Restore the hold check with set_multicycle_path N-1 -hold
Rank overlapping exceptions with false paths first, then max and min delay, then multicycle

label: Exceptions as claims
subgoals: State the behavior each exception assumes
Keep exceptions narrow and specific to a mode
Prove or review every exception that hides a failing path
